document: The exact original 10-K/10-Q accession supplying each prediction's financial features. Issuer, form and public date must match, and publication must precede prediction.
normalization: Visible filing text only; discard hidden XBRL, scripts/styles/head/noscript and hidden DOM nodes. Frequencies per 10000 words, not assertions of legal distress.
acquisition: Resumable document cache shared across the base and precommitted expanded training phases. Missing source/text is never zero. No final documents before frozen development selection.
